say:2:1035008001:1.text: It's not only us who know. The Windwhisperers have already spread the word throughout the forests and mountains.
say:2:1035008001:1.source_cn: 不止是我们知道，风语者已经在丛林和山脉通告了一切。

say:3:1035008002:1.text: I never would have expected Master Eomir to unite with outsiders to corrupt our home.
say:3:1035008002:1.source_cn: 真没想到……伊米尔竟然会联合外人腐化家园……他明明是大贤者。

say:4:1035008003:1.text: Luckily, it was all stopped in time.
say:4:1035008003:1.source_cn: 不过好在这一切都被及时制止。

say:5:1035008004:1.text: I tried to tell you! The rude scoundrel!
say:5:1035008004:1.source_cn: 我早说过！他是个没礼貌的人！

say:6:1035008005:1.text: At least his little conspiracy was put to bed before it could cause any lasting damage.
say:6:1035008005:1.source_cn: 还好他的阴谋被及时制止，没有生出更糟的恶果……
